title: JSON Schema for derived ncbi_vs_gtdb files
description: Schema for sheets derived from the ncbi_vs_gtdb_*.xlsx files provided by GTDB. These files represent the correspondence between GTDB and NCBI taxa, ordered by degree of polyphyly.

ncbi_taxon.description: Name of the NCBI taxonomic group

n_genomes.description: number of genomes associated with the named taxonomic group

n_gtdb_taxa.description: number of genomes associated with the named taxonomic group

gtdb_taxon.description: Name of the GTDB taxonomic group

score.description: Score in percent to two dp.

rank.description: Taxonomic rank of the named group
